- Bed/bath conflict: 3bd/3ba (2014 MLS, Zillow), 4bd/3ba (county), 4bd/2.5ba (Redfin). AIVRE MLS autofill showed 2 full + 1 half. Bonus room may have been converted to a 4th bedroom (check permits). Downstairs bath type (full vs half) left blank.
- 12 total rooms: county records (countyoffice / NeighborWho).
- Heating Forced Warm Air: 2014 MLS 'HVAC Central, Forced Air' (KW) + county 'Heating Central'. Fuel not stated - left blank. MLS - verify.
- Cooling Centralized: 2014 MLS 'Central' (KW) and Redfin 'Has A/C'. MLS - verify.
- Fireplace 1 (family room): 2014 MLS remarks. MLS - verify (prep packet mentions possibly 2).
- Construction 'Wood' (framing) per county record - wall finish material not stated, so exterior walls left blank.
- Slab? county lists primary flooring 'Concrete/Cement' only - NOT used as foundation type; left blank.
- Garage: 2 spaces, attached: Redfin '2 garage spaces', 2014 MLS '2 parking spaces', AIVRE MLS autofill 'attached'. MLS - verify.
- Private inground pool & spa: 2014 MLS remarks 'private sparkling swimming pool and spa'. MLS - verify still present, barrier, equipment.
- Interior per 2014 MLS: freshly painted, new carpet upstairs (2014 - likely changed since). Not entered as current.
- Lot: conflict 7,432 sf / 134x60 (countyoffice), 7,449 (AIVRE autofill), 8,040 (Redfin), 8,058 (Zillow). Use assessor.
- Taxes ~$10,735/yr (NeighborWho, unverified). Last sale 06/20/2014 $905,000 (Redfin). No listing since.
- Not filled (no source): style/design, wall/roof/window materials, foundation, utilities, street type/surface, access (gated tract streets may be private), view, zoning, flood zone, lender, due date, inspection items, ratings.
